name: Bunker Brawl
description: The team has been cornered in a subterranean bunker. It's a close-quarters slugfest with heavy concrete pillars and narrow firing lanes.
scenario_rules: Bunker Brawl: Confined spaces double the explosive damage due to the Chunky Salsa effect. High cover bonuses apply behind pillars.

zones.name: Concrete Pillar
zones.description: Thick reinforced pillars offering excellent protection.

zones.name: Command Console
zones.description: A central tactical console, providing some cover and access to bunker systems.
